name: UI：视频上传节点-空值保存边界(空商品ID+空视频URL)
description: 验证视频上传节点在商品ID和视频URL均为空时点击保存的行为：应弹出必填校验提示或阻止保存

steps.expression: return (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a,button')).filter(el => el.textContent.trim() === '打开'); if(btns.length > 0) { btns[0].click(); return 'clicked'; } return 'no open btn'; })()

return (() => { const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal'); for (const m of modals) { if (m.classList.contains('ant-modal-hidden')) continue; const r = m.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width < 200) continue; const cards = m.querySelectorAll('.ant-card-hoverable, .ant-card'); for (const card of cards) { const t = card.querySelector('.ant-card-meta-title'); if (t && t.textContent.trim() === '视频上传') { card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); card.click(); return { ok: true }; } } } return { ok: false }; })()

steps.description: 等待视频上传编辑抽屉加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); const fields = {}; for (const item of formItems) { const label = (item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); const input = item.querySelector('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio])'); if (label.includes('商品') && input) { const val = input.value || ''; fields.itemId = { value: val, required: !!item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-required'), hasRequiredMark: !!item.querySelector('[class*=required]') }; } if (label.includes('视频') && !label.includes('上传') && input) { const val = input.value || ''; fields.video = { value: val, required: !!item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-required'), hasRequiredMark: !!item.querySelector('[class*=required]') }; } } return { open: true, fields }; })()
steps.description: 检查商品ID和视频字段的必填标记

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const formItems = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item')); for (const item of formItems) { const label = (item.querySelector('.ant-form-item-label')?.textContent || '').trim(); const input = item.querySelector('input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio])'); if (label.includes('商品') && input) { input.focus(); input.blur(); } } return { ok: true, triggered: 'itemId blur' }; })()
steps.description: 触发商品ID字段校验(聚焦后失焦)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const errors = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, .ant-form-item-explain, [class*=error], [class*=Error]')); const errorTexts = errors.map(e => (e.textContent || '').trim()).filter(Boolean); const hasValidationError = errors.length > 0; return { hasValidationError, errorCount: errors.length, errorTexts: errorTexts.slice(0, 5) }; })()
steps.description: 检查是否有校验错误提示

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { ok: false }; const saveBtn = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => { const t = (b.textContent || '').trim(); return t === '保 存' || t === '保存'; }); if (saveBtn) { saveBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()

return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); const errors = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, .ant-message-error, .ant-message-warning, [class*=error]'); const errorMsgs = Array.from(errors).map(e => (e.textContent || '').trim()).filter(Boolean); const globalMsgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message .ant-message-notice')).map(m => (m.textContent || '').trim()); const stillOpen = !!drawer; return { stillOpen, errorMsgs: errorMsgs.slice(0, 5), globalMsgs: globalMsgs.slice(0, 5), blocked: stillOpen }; })()
steps.description: 检查空值保存结果(是否被阻止)

steps.expression: return (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden) .ant-drawer-close'); if(c) c.click(); return 'closed'; })()

视频URL为空保存时是否弹出必填校验提示
保存按钮是否会阻止空值提交
